title: GMUT disformal-map invertibility, causal-cone, and matter-metric obligation tribunal
hypothesis: A typed formal tribunal can reject a proposed frame map unless its invertibility domain, singular branches, causal-cone effects, matter coupling metric, and observable dictionary are explicit.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate conformal and disformal factors, scalar-gradient norm, Jacobian rank, inverse branch, matter metric, cone relation, observable map, and claim class; any singular, ambiguous, or promoted row must fail.
boundary: Structural or proxy acceptance is confined to the declared model. It does not promote empirical, participant, authority, production, security, accessibility, identity, or Stage 20 claims.
